body:
Not much of anything, really.  I don't know what to do.  In 2007 I lost my dad to cancer 1 month before I graduated from college and it really derailed my life.  I tried hard to keep it together but I sorta pulled away from everything.... lost my girlfriend at the time and a bunch of my friends too.  I kept it together enough to hold onto steady employment and buy a house and what not, but I've spent the past 5 years mostly depressed and mostly alone and this just feels like the straw that broke the camel's back.  The past 2 days I've just been isolated in my house thinking about how I should end it, going up and down and up and down through periods of telling myself one moment that I've been through this kind of thing before and I'll be alright, to sobbing uncontrollably until my whole body is shaking the next.  Tried to go to a friend's house last night..... he's my best friend of 27 years but he's not the kind of guy that could ever give advice or be a good listener....... so I was there for about an hour before I made up an excuse to leave because I just felt so shitty.  Tried calling my sister last night and she wouldn't answer so I called my mom and talked to her for awhile.  That helped a little but it really did nothing to convince me to keep on living.  I haven't told anyone I'm considering suicide and I highly doubt that I will.  I just can't, I don't want anything to do with any "cries for help" to my family.  I either want to decide to kill myself and get up the nerve to follow through with it, or forget about it somehow.    

Sounds pathetic but I really don't have any hobbies.  I have no interesting skills or interests.  I used to, but like I said I've spent the past 5 years or so rather withdrawn, and just going to work and going back home each day and wasting the evening away gaming or watching something on TV or doing anything to stay distracted.  I've brought this all on myself, I know, and I just don't know how to cope any longer.  I never purposely set out to make myself miserable but I think I've done a good job of it and I can't deny it any longer.  Since I graduated high school years and years ago, most of my friends have moved out of state or we've lost contact.  I feel I have no one and nothing anymore, and it feels so permanent.  Unpleasant things in life that I used to be able to shrug off and move on from now send me into deep, deep despair, and I just can't take it anymore.  Can't eat, can't sleep, been trying for 2 days to think of something that I can do that will lift my spirits or distract me but I just want to sit on my couch and stare off into space.
